text:
inc-bot: paging: SEV2 detected: /v1/generate p99 latency > 3s for last 5m · possible KV cache pressure on rpc-cluster-7 · runbook: https://runbooks.internal/latency-kv

elaine (oncall): seeing it on the dashboard, p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~780ms last 10m. streaming stalls reported by clients.

kevin (sre): confirmed. grafana: p50 150ms, p95 780ms, p99 3.2s, error rate negligible. lots of long tail. heatmap shows heavy tail around 1.5-3s.

prasanna (runtime): logs from node rpc-cluster-7: repeated warnings: `kv_prefill_eviction_count=842` and `kv_decode_wait_ms=1200` and some `kv_fragmented_pages=true`. suspect prefill vs decode imbalance — too many concurrent prefill tasks evicting hot KV entries.

bryan (eng-runtime): yep. recent change to prefill concurrency (rollout 05:00 UTC) raised max_prefill_jobs from 16->64 on the cluster to speed cold-starts. that probably caused aggressive eviction. rolling back now.

elaine (oncall): can we reduce prefill concurrency and bump cache threshold? what's safe to change in prod without restart?

prasanna (runtime): we can lower `max_prefill_jobs` via dynamic flags: `rwctl set cluster.rpc-cluster-7 max_prefill_jobs=16` — no restart. also raise `kv_cache_high_watermark` from 0.6->0.8 to reduce eviction frequency. will take effect immediately.

kevin (sre): doing it now. running: `rwctl set cluster.rpc-cluster-7 max_prefill_jobs=16 && rwctl set cluster.rpc-cluster-7 kv_cache_high_watermark=0.8`

ops-bot: accepted change requests, deploying flags to rpc-cluster-7 (canary 10% -> roll 100%).

kevin (sre): canary applied. monitoring p95/p99 closely. also temporarily enabling fallback routing: route 10% of traffic from rpc-cluster-7 to rpc-cluster-8 (older model variant with smaller KV working set).

tanvi (pm): customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers reported UI stalls and streaming pauses via support tickets. SLAs at risk for a few large accounts. need a brief external comms?

elaine (oncall): I'll coordinate with support. for now mitigation first.

(3m later)

prasanna (runtime): after lowering prefill jobs and raising watermark: p95 down to 300-400ms, p99 down to ~1s. streaming stalls decreased. eviction rate dropped ~85%.

bryan (eng-runtime): good. still seeing occasional tail at ~1.5s correlated with large sequence lengths (>4k tokens) and fragmented KV pages. fragmentation caused by mixed quantized model variants on same host.

kevin (sre): next steps: 1) keep dynamic flags, 2) cordon heavy hosts and shift traffic, 3) schedule maintenance to defragment KV store (offline compaction), 4) roll back the prefill concurrency change permanently until we have throttling in prefill scheduler.

elaine (oncall): action items assigned:
- prasanna: monitor and keep flags for 1h, revert only after 30m stable
- bryan: prepare compaction playbook + paged maintenance window (ETA 2h)
- kevin: traffic shift plan and customer comm blurb
- tanvi: coordinate customer comms for impacted enterprise accounts

prasanna (runtime): taking ownership of monitoring. will post updates every 10m.

kevin (sre): shifting 15% traffic off rpc-cluster-7 now -> applying route weight changes. `routectl set-weight cluster rpc-cluster-7 85` `routectl set-weight cluster rpc-cluster-8 15`

ops-bot: route weights updated.

(10m later)

prasanna (runtime): metrics stable. p95 ~220ms, p99 ~700ms. eviction_count trending down. streaming stalls reduced to baseline.

elaine (oncall): excellent. starting handoff soon. oncall shift ends in 20m. who will take next?

bryan (eng-runtime): I can take the handoff and own the compaction plan. will be on-call-ready.

elaine (oncall): handing off to bryan in 10m. bryan, please confirm you have runbook links and can revert flags if needed.

bryan (eng-runtime): confirmed. runbooks: https://runbooks.internal/kv-prefill ; https://runbooks.internal/kv-compaction. I have admin to `rwctl` and `routectl`. will monitor for 1h and then schedule compaction if stable.

kevin (sre): I'll draft a short customer note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls due to internal KV cache pressure; we've applied mitigations and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary." will loop in support.

tanvi (pm): ping support to send the note to impacted customers, mark tickets as under-investigation.

elaine (oncall): handing off. bryan, you own timeline and postmortem. I'll update pager rota.

bryan (eng-runtime): taking over — will keep thread updated. planning compaction at T+2h window if metrics stay healthy.

inc-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded to SEV3.

elaine (oncall): final note before off: root cause likely the recent prefill concurrency change combined with mixed-model fragmentation on some hosts; temporary fix applied. bryan to run compaction and coordinate permanent config change.

bryan (eng-runtime): will produce a short postmortem draft and update runbook with a prefill throttling checklist.

kevin (sre): adding timeline and metrics graph to the incident doc. will attach flamegraphs and logs: `s3://incidents/2069001234/*`.

(shift end)

elaine (oncall): signing off. thanks team. :heart:

bryan (eng-runtime): ack, taking over.
